notes: Stories created for EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN covering schema, logic, integration, and tests.

EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S1.title: Define Travel Burden Schema and Contract
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S1.description: Define structured schema for travel distance, duration, and metadata for trial locations including units, null handling, and error states.

EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S2.title: Implement Travel Burden Computation Logic
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S2.description: Implement core logic to compute travel distance and duration between user location and trial sites using _get_travel_info, including batching and fallback handling.

EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S3.title: Expose Travel Burden via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S3.description: Integrate travel burden data into evaluate_care_facade so trial results include distance and duration for each location.

EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S4.title: Integrate Google Routes API for Travel Data
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S4.description: Implement and validate integration with Google Routes API including request formatting, API key usage, rate limits, and error handling.

EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Travel Burden
EVAL-TRAVEL-BURDEN-S5.description: Create unit tests for travel computation logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from trial search to travel burden output.
